title: The daily Journey prompt reaches every enrolled member and respects the in-app Practice setting

source.ref: Journey audit 2026-11-17 (project thread: Dial in the Journey Wizard and Journeys)

detail: listEnrolledMemberIds read active journey_enrollments once with no range, order or error check; PostgREST caps a read at max_rows = 1000 (supabase/config.toml) even for the service role, so past 1000 active enrolment rows an arbitrary set of members silently missed their morning prompt, and a failed read looked like nobody enrolled. The journey-prompt cron also inserted the in-app notification without the ADR-169 send gate, so a member who turned in-app Practice notices off still got the daily prompt (the push leg already checked its own preference). Fixed 2026-11-17: listEnrolledMemberIds reads ordered 1000-row pages until a short page and throws on an error; the cron inserts the in-app row only when resolveSendGate(profile, 'inapp', 'practice') allows it. route.test.ts mocks the gate and pins the new refusal.

verify.note: Fails if listEnrolledMemberIds stops paging or swallows an error, or the prompt cron bypasses the send gate.
